platforms.name: ACCESS
platforms.funding: NSF-funded coordination + separately funded resource providers
platforms.route: ACCESS project request; exchange credits for provider resources
platforms.fit: Broad CPU/GPU research and instruction; resource discovery and support.
platforms.boundary: Provider quotas, scheduling, allocation term and software vary. Counts overlap with participating resource providers.

platforms.name: OSG Open Science Pool (OSPool)
platforms.route: OSG Portal / facilitated access point
platforms.fit: Independent text/image analyses, parameter sweeps, model evaluation and many short CPU/GPU jobs.
platforms.boundary: Interruptible fair share; complete/checkpoint jobs within 20 hours. Educational project fit needs facilitation; no classroom GPU reservation.

platforms.name: PATh Facility
platforms.route: Consult PATh; NSF-funded project startup/credit process
platforms.fit: Larger HTC research jobs and reliable resource profiles; relevant to MESA-funded work.
platforms.boundary: NSF research scope/credits required. Different from free fair-share OSPool; consultation is not automatic authorization.

platforms.name: NRP / Nautilus
platforms.route: Institutional onboarding; hosted JupyterHub, API or project namespace
platforms.fit: Hosted teaching notebooks, GPUs, open-weight model APIs and containerized services.
platforms.boundary: Shared capacity, account policies and operator responsibilities; Nautilus is the NRP cluster, not a separate pool.

platforms.name: Jetstream2
platforms.route: ACCESS allocation, course images and student/project access
platforms.fit: Notebooks, RStudio, desktops, web/database teaching servers and vGPU environments.
platforms.boundary: Budget credits for always-on instances, term duration, data backup and GPU demand. Not permanent institutional hosting.

platforms.name: NAIRR / NAIRR Classroom
platforms.route: Appropriate researcher or Classroom request
platforms.fit: AI coursework, GPUs, model/data/tools and selected managed environments.
platforms.boundary: US-based class eligibility and approved resources; instructor/TA support expected. Research and Classroom requests differ; partner offerings are not all federally purchased.

platforms.name: CloudBank / CloudBank Classroom
platforms.kind: Commercial-cloud broker and managed teaching platform
platforms.route: ACCESS/NAIRR route appropriate to requested service
platforms.fit: Managed Python/R/C++ browser environments with login and student storage.
platforms.boundary: Approved budget/term, provider configuration and GPU availability; not a commercial free tier. Check actual onboarding terminology with CloudBank.

platforms.name: Chameleon / CHI@Edge
platforms.route: Eligible PI project; allocation and resource lease
platforms.fit: Systems/MLOps, edge/IoT, bare-metal experiments, specialized GPU/FPGA hardware.
platforms.boundary: Experiment purpose, SU budget and short hardware leases. No unrestricted production hosting; student membership normally follows PI approval.

platforms.name: CloudLab
platforms.route: Approved project with planned class reservations
platforms.fit: Distributed systems, reproducible root-access labs and networked application experiments.
platforms.boundary: Use only while actively experimenting; node data disappears at termination. Reserve for deadline bursts and export work.

platforms.name: FABRIC
platforms.route: Project and experimental resource slices
platforms.fit: Distributed AI, edge workloads, streaming/data movement and instrument-to-compute experiments.
platforms.boundary: Experiment should need the network/testbed capabilities; not a stand-alone generic GPU account or production campus server.

platforms.name: NSF NCAR Derecho / analysis resources
platforms.route: Classroom/workshop or qualifying research allocation
platforms.fit: Earth-system, environmental and geospatial data/AI instruction with consulting.
platforms.boundary: Earth-system mission fit; setup lead time, accounts, dates and reservations required. Separate grant not required for eligible classes.

platforms.name: DOE NERSC / ALCF / OLCF
platforms.route: ALCC, INCITE or facility-specific merit request
platforms.fit: Large mission-aligned scientific simulation, data analysis and AI research.
platforms.boundary: ALCC does not require DOE sponsorship, but merit/mission/scaling requirements apply. Not the default for everyday college labs.

platforms.name: NASA High-End Computing
platforms.route: NASA-sponsored project / mission request process
platforms.fit: NASA-aligned Earth/space/engineering computing.
platforms.boundary: Sponsorship and mission/award review required; not a general open classroom resource.

platforms.name: NIH AnVIL / Terra ecosystem
platforms.funding: NIH NHGRI platform funding; cloud usage billed separately
platforms.route: Project/data authorization plus cloud billing or awarded credits
platforms.fit: Genomic data-science notebooks, workflows and reproducible biomedical training.
platforms.boundary: Free platform browsing does not mean free compute/storage/egress. NIH AnVIL differs from Purdue ACCESS Anvil; old credit calls are not current offers.

platforms.name: CyVerse Discovery Environment / VICE
platforms.funding: Historical core NSF support; new project funding + subscriptions + Arizona TRIF
platforms.kind: Managed applications and scientific data platform
platforms.route: Basic account; confirm institutional Pro or collaboration access
platforms.fit: Python/R apps, data management and a practical UArizona course/pilot route.
platforms.boundary: Basic 200 units/year, 5 GB, one job and no sharing/public links. Published UArizona free Pro is state-funded, not universal; GPU and class access need consultation.
platforms.status: Mixed funding; current published UArizona benefit

platforms.name: Open Storage Network
platforms.funding: NSF seed support + participating storage operators
platforms.route: Separate storage request through ACCESS; provider capacity
platforms.fit: Large actively used teaching/research datasets and portable object storage.
platforms.boundary: Documented request range 10–50 TB; not CPU time, backup or archival permanence. Actual size/site capacity needs verification.

platforms.name: OSDF / Pelican
platforms.route: Connect existing store or allocated OSN/CC* storage through OSG
platforms.fit: Deliver data to distributed jobs, notebooks and scientific applications.
platforms.boundary: Not another storage or compute award. Backing store/access policy required; not for highly regulated/PII/HIPAA data; preservation is separate.
platforms.parent: OSG data layer; interoperates with OSPool / OSN

platforms.name: MESA
platforms.funding: NSF IDSS; project site cites award 2632685
platforms.route: Published MESA portal/docs; underlying services govern compute
platforms.fit: Metadata, semantic discovery, reproducible data/agent workflows, Jupyter/R/desktop app layer.
platforms.boundary: Published tools are not a verified class service level. Underlying CyVerse/TACC/ACCESS/NAIRR allocations, GPU entitlement and support remain distinct.
platforms.status: Funded expansion; published portal/tools, readiness untested

platforms.name: National Data Platform (NDP)
platforms.route: Public catalog/education activity; consult NDP for class workspace
platforms.fit: Discoverable compute-ready instructional data, reusable AI activities and capstone content.
platforms.boundary: Some homepage features are forthcoming. Confirm available workspaces, quota, onboarding and underlying compute rather than equating an IDSS grant with a user allocation.

platforms.name: Fabric for AI-Driven Science (FabAID)
platforms.route: Project service endpoints/consultation
platforms.fit: Storage federation, cache/delivery, transformation, discovery and data-intensive workflows.
platforms.boundary: Data-service integration complements compute allocations; no universal GPU entitlement, class quota or archival guarantee established.
platforms.status: Funded deployment; service-specific terms to confirm

platforms.name: Interactive Discovery Laboratory (iDLab)
platforms.route: Project consultation; existing site account/allocations as required
platforms.fit: Browser applications, interactive workspaces and cross-site data/workflow access.
platforms.boundary: Participating sites retain policies/control. Gateway access is not an extra copy of the sites’ capacity or long-term archives; course readiness must be confirmed.

platforms.name: BRIDGE National Center / Apache Texera
platforms.route: Project collaboration or own supported platform deployment
platforms.fit: Visual/no-code workflows, reproducible social-science/data analyses and shared community models.
platforms.boundary: May require your own host/cloud/resources and operators. No verified no-cost public compute subscription or guaranteed class capacity.

platforms.name: National Science Data Fabric (NSDF)
platforms.route: Project contact; NSF announcement verifies expansion scope
platforms.fit: Standardized scientific data discovery/access, reproducibility and data/AI workforce development.
platforms.boundary: Funding/intent verified from NSF announcement; current user-specific access terms, compute quota and production readiness not established in this review.

platforms.name: Open OnDemand + JupyterHub / BinderHub
platforms.funding: Open OnDemand federal-supported development; site funds operation
platforms.route: Use provider-installed portal or deploy on approved compute
platforms.fit: Notebooks, RStudio, VS Code, remote desktops and visual/science gateways.
platforms.boundary: Software is not hardware/time allocation. Only Open OnDemand’s funding is evidenced here; no claim that every JupyterHub installation is federally funded. Operators and backing resources remain necessary.

platforms.name: Pegasus / HTCondor / ACCESS Pegasus
platforms.kind: Workflow orchestration and job execution products
platforms.route: Hosted ACCESS Pegasus with active allocation; OSG/PATh tools
platforms.fit: Portable multi-step pipelines, task sweeps, data staging and transparent execution.
platforms.boundary: Uses existing allocations/pools; does not create another pool. Software portability is not data preservation or a substitute for operations.

platforms.name: CILogon / Globus
platforms.funding: Historical federal development/integration; current operations include subscriptions
platforms.kind: Identity, authorization and research data movement
platforms.route: Institution/provider identity configuration and endpoint support
platforms.fit: Campus login, role-based access, data transfer and cross-site workflow connections.
platforms.boundary: Basic services may be free while advanced support/sharing costs. Neither supplies a compute/storage allocation; CILogon says operations shifted to subscriptions in 2019.

platforms.name: Science gateways / SGX3
platforms.funding: NSF-funded SGX3; substantial operations can be client-funded
platforms.route: Gateway consultation/community resources; project-specific gateway accounts
platforms.fit: Usable domain applications and teaching interfaces beyond raw HPC command lines.
platforms.boundary: Limited funded planning/UX/training differs from paid development/hosting/operations. A gateway catalog is not a universal free app-hosting plan.

platforms.name: IDSS program
platforms.kind: Operator grant program, not a compute account
platforms.route: Institutional proposal / funded project collaboration
platforms.fit: National data-service development, transition to operations and planning.
platforms.boundary: Six named 2026 projects have different services/stages; the grant does not award every instructor CPU/GPU hours.

platforms.name: Campus Cyberinfrastructure (CC*)
platforms.route: Institutional funding process; actual local award/service rules
platforms.fit: Campus compute, networking, data storage/digital archives and integration.
platforms.boundary: Current page has no upcoming due dates and awaits new guidelines. Not an open national classroom account; sharing, operation and stewardship have to be funded.
platforms.status: Program; current page awaiting new publication

platforms.name: Major Research Instrumentation (MRI)
platforms.route: Institutional limited-submission/award process
platforms.fit: Appropriate shared instrumentation and computing-linked research training.
platforms.boundary: Current solicitation, instrument eligibility and campus proposal limits matter. A funding route is not a ready device/GPU account; this map does not assert an open submission window.

platforms.name: State / Regional AI Infrastructure Hubs
platforms.funding: NSF pays coordination/workforce/education; partners pay infrastructure
platforms.route: Institution/state/regional consortium; actual award and resource terms
platforms.fit: Faculty course development, facilitators, shared AI-service coordination and regional scale.
platforms.boundary: NSF does not acquire/fund the compute infrastructure under this solicitation. Partners must sustain it; no awarded Arizona hub is verified here.

platforms.name: SCIPE / CyberTraining / ACCESS facilitation
platforms.route: Existing facilitator/training services or institutional grant pathway
platforms.fit: Support ownership, instructor onboarding, reusable course materials and train-the-trainer capacity.
platforms.boundary: Grant programs do not promise staff for every instructor. Current call status and actual support agreements must be checked; college effort is still required.

gaps.title: Many small jobs, not one big notebook
gaps.body: Add OSPool/PATh and checkpointed workflow execution for corpus processing, parameter sweeps and independent model evaluation.

gaps.title: Managed teaching environments
gaps.body: Map CloudBank Classroom, Jetstream2 course images, NRP hubs and eligible CyVerse apps separately from raw GPU allocations.

gaps.title: Inference as an API
gaps.body: NRP-hosted model APIs and requested NAIRR model/software access can support assignments without every student operating a GPU server.

gaps.title: Data-first services
gaps.body: MESA, NDP, FabAID, iDLab, BRIDGE and NSDF supply discovery, metadata, reusable workflows and cross-site access; their grants are not all compute accounts.

gaps.title: Object storage, caches and movement
gaps.body: OSN stores active data; OSDF/Pelican distributes it; Globus moves it. None automatically provides archive permanence or all operating costs.

gaps.title: Systems, networks and specialized hardware
gaps.body: Chameleon, CloudLab and FABRIC support systems/edge/distributed experiments and specialized hardware. Use only when the testbed purpose matches.

gaps.title: Campus delivery and staff funding
gaps.body: Open OnDemand, gateways, identity, orchestration, grant-funded facilitators and college operators make allocations teachable. Compute awards alone do not fund all of them.

gaps.title: Domain facilities and mixed funding
gaps.body: DOE, NASA and NIH add mission-specific routes. CC*/MRI can fund campus capability; AI Hubs and CyVerse/UArizona show why state, subscription and federal support need separate labels.

research.method: Exa discovery and primary federal/provider documents with targeted direct-live checks. Requested slots are not independently verified source counts. No accounts, allocations, GPU calls, cloud charges, grant submissions or private-project materials were used.
boundaries: Federal development funding is different from current operations or no-cost user access.
ACCESS providers, NRP/Nautilus and OSG/OSPool/OSDF must not be double-counted.
IDSS projects have distinct integration roles and maturity; no generic user quota is implied.
Arizona TRIF is state funding; AI Infrastructure Hubs require partners to finance compute.
Allocated service storage is not automatic archival preservation.
